title: Resource Allocation and Stage Reviews in Long-Term Projects
prompt: Some people argue that organisations should allocate resources evenly across all stages of a long-term project to maintain steady progress. Others believe that resources should be concentrated at critical stages, with formal reviews to decide whether to continue, adjust, or terminate the project. Discuss both views and give your own opinion. Write at least 250 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟雅思学术类写作Task 2练习，所有场景与数据均为虚构，非官方雅思试卷。请针对题目中的两种观点进行讨论，并明确给出你自己的立场。建议先分别阐述两种观点的理由，再结合实例（如项目管理、公共工程等）说明你的看法。注意保持论证清晰、结构合理，使用恰当的学术语言。字数不少于250词。
